title: Plan My Wedding
description:
Plan My Wedding brings your venue search, vendor bookings, budget, checklist, guest list, invitations and inspiration together in one calm, beautiful workspace.

DISCOVER THE RIGHT VENDORS

Browse venues, photographers, makeup artists, decorators, caterers, DJs, mehendi artists and more. Compare details, save favourites, request quotes and keep booking information organised.

KEEP EVERY DETAIL ON TRACK

Build a personalised checklist, monitor your budget and track the decisions that turn a wedding idea into a real plan. Your dashboard keeps the next important tasks easy to find.

MANAGE GUESTS AND INVITATIONS

Create digital invitations, organise guest details and follow RSVPs from one place. Share a polished invitation experience with family and friends.

PLAN WITH AI ASSISTANCE

Use the planning assistant for ideas grounded in your wedding profile, budget and preferences. AI suggestions are planning aids and can always be reviewed before you act.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Choose when to share location, control notifications, update your details, and permanently delete your account from Settings.

Some vendor services, payments and availability are provided by independent third parties. Internet access is required for account sync and live features.
